dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look here! It's a book named "A Guide to Clandestine Contact With the Fatui"... Paimon wonders if we can find clues regarding the Fatui operation stronghold here...

dialogues.speaker: "A Guide to Clandestine Contact With the Fatui"
dialogues.text: "At night, go near the tents in Apam Woods. Light four torches there..."

dialogues.speaker: "A Guide to Clandestine Contact With the Fatui"
dialogues.text: "Then, go towards the signal lights. The stronghold lies where the lights come from..." Wow, so this is how they've been communicating...

dialogues.speaker: "A Guide to Clandestine Contact With the Fatui"
dialogues.text: "Remember, the code is: Never bring your own rule book to someone else's place..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #They even have a code! {NICKNAME}, let's give it a try. "Never bring your own rule book..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They say "never bring your own rule book to someone else's place," but hmph! The Fatui brought this contact rule with them to Sumeru...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's go to Apam Woods and get those Fatui!
